title: Sunday · Last Bell, 2005
logline: The school at the last bell from across the road, three tiers: the bell, the doors, the road to the beach with the kids on it and a man and a dog on the far sidewalk, not moving.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the high school from across the road at 3:05, a jagged bell shape at the door.

image.prompt: a small-town high school seen from across a road with a jagged sound shape at the front door, watercolor

panels.name: Bell

panels.composition: Tier 2: the doors open, students pouring out toward the beach road.

image.prompt: students pouring out of a school's front doors toward a beach road, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Doors

panels.composition: Tier 3: the far sidewalk: a man in a chore coat and a dog, still, the crowd passing.
